suggestions.title: Everything Everywhere All at Once
suggestions.description: A middle-aged Chinese immigrant discovers she can access the memories and skills of alternate-universe versions of herself, and must use this power to save the multiverse from destruction. A wildly inventive, hilarious, and deeply heartfelt masterpiece.

suggestions.title: The Green Mile
suggestions.description: A death row prison guard discovers that one of his inmates possesses a mysterious, supernatural gift that challenges everything he thought he knew about justice, humanity, and miracles in this powerful Stephen King adaptation.

suggestions.title: Coco
suggestions.description: A young boy named Miguel dreams of becoming a musician in a family that has banned music for generations. On Día de Muertos, he finds himself in the Land of the Dead and embarks on a journey to uncover his family's true history.
